scope: one-host four-process isolated laboratory acceptance replay, not a deployment reset recipe
validity: all static intents retain [1,257); no automatic renewal if actual packing takes too many heights
confirmation_time: client all-four receipt observations, not internal durable timestamp

rounds.static_65536_feasibility: 1024 full candidates need 64 heights; actual packing/rounds must still finish every signed row within [1,257), otherwise fail without extending or renewing signed intents
rounds.input_identity: one in-memory signed corpus replayed byte-identically across CPU/GPU/CPU
rounds.signature_generation_timing: all workload signing excluded before first submission
rounds.environment_scope: explicit inherited settings; null means unset, not an effective AOEM default or device identity

unmeasured.scope: logical signed-input and application-object sizes are not physical wire traffic or retransmission counts

rounds.apfl_size_measurement_scope: untimed reconstruction from the exact submitted signed corpus; canonical expanded bytes and lossless APFL bytes preserve every signature; application_object_bytes also includes original native envelope, neither is physical/retransmitted UDP traffic
rounds.phase: cold restart all receipts balances and authorizations

latency_us.definition: first native wire-frame submission attempt to slowest of four receipt-query observations; includes initial execution/consensus wait and bounded observer; not an internal finality timestamp

rounds.timing: same native load drive: first SDK submission attempt through every unique four-node receipt-query observation; startup/keygen/signing/structure preparation/untimed economics/cold recovery excluded
